definitions.name: Leadership capabilities
definitions.description: Capabilities of the country's leadership and how effectively it governs.
definitions.coverage_notes: WGI Government Effectiveness (2025 revision, 0-100) is the institutional proxy: quality of public services, civil service, policy formulation and implementation. It measures state capacity, not individual leaders — no subjective leader ratings. Capped PARTIAL: one governance dimension is not the whole leadership-capabilities concept (Sprint 6.21, DEC-041).

definitions.name: Education
definitions.description: Quality and reach of the country's education system and human capital.
definitions.coverage_notes: Live input: OECD tertiary attainment age 25-34 (ISCED 5-8, % of population, annual, Sprint 5.20). Attainment != enrollment. CHN has only 1 data point (2010); IND has 8 sparse data points. Still missing: secondary attainment/enrollment, learning outcomes/test scores, education quality, years of schooling, skills. One tertiary series cannot make Education AVAILABLE — capped at PARTIAL.

definitions.name: Character / determination
definitions.description: Resourcefulness and determination of the population.
definitions.coverage_notes: PARTIAL proxy (V1 Mission 1, delegated working model): the executable component measures RELATIVE ECONOMIC PARTICIPATION — labour force participation rate (ILO modeled, ages 15+) scored as a WDI-universe percentile. This is a narrow, labeled proxy for economic participation only; it is NOT a measurement of national character or determination. Resourcefulness, entrepreneurship and innovation dimensions remain unmeasured. PARTIAL ceiling enforced; higher participation is not universally positive (documented limitation).

definitions.name: Rule of law
definitions.description: Respect for law and contracts; objective measurement of legal system quality.
definitions.coverage_notes: World Bank WGI Rule of Law governance score (2025 revision, 0-100 absolute scale) live 1996-2024 for all 8 countries. Perception-based composite with measurement uncertainty (90% CI bounds and number of sources exist as separate WGI series, not yet imported). This is a SOURCE indicator for the force, not an Atlas force score.

definitions.name: Corruption
definitions.description: Prevalence of corruption and rent-seeking behavior.
definitions.coverage_notes: Source is WGI 'Control of Corruption' (2025 revision, 0-100): HIGHER means stronger control of corruption / less corruption — the raw stored value is never reversed or reinterpreted. Perception-based composite with measurement uncertainty. This is a SOURCE indicator, not an Atlas force score.

definitions.name: Resource allocation efficiency
definitions.description: How efficiently capital, labor, and talent are allocated across the economy.
definitions.coverage_notes: Investment & resource-allocation CONTEXT profile (Mission 4 §17): investment effort (GCF % of GDP), output growth, and labour productivity describe the input side — none of them measures allocation efficiency itself, and all three overlap productivity / infrastructure inputs by design (documented, not deduplicated).

definitions.name: Global openness
definitions.description: Openness to trade, capital, people, and ideas.
definitions.coverage_notes: Descriptive openness CONTEXT profile (Mission 4 §16): trade intensity (exports+imports % of GDP, exposed as derived TRADE_OPENNESS_GDP), external balance, current account, FDI inflows, plus population/GDP size context as candidates. Trade intensity is NOT strength (DEC-035) and these inputs overlap trade_capital_flows deliberately. The full force (capital, people, ideas) remains unmeasurable — no level score is claimed.

definitions.name: Productivity / output growth
definitions.description: Growth of output and productivity of the economy.
definitions.coverage_notes: OECD labour productivity per hour (6/8 countries — CHN/IND are not OECD members and cannot receive an OECD-calibrated score). Sprint 6.14 (DEC-042 Option A — owner approved): level = mid-rank percentile within the versioned OECD universe oecd_lpph_v1, period-specific. Capped PARTIAL: OECD relative productivity position only — not the whole productivity/output-growth force, not a global percentile.

definitions.name: Cost competitiveness
definitions.description: Relative cost position of the country's producers versus competitors.
definitions.coverage_notes: ULC growth is relative-cost meaningful; CPI inflation is a domestic price-pressure input. Relative international competitiveness ultimately needs exchange rates and partner-country price/cost comparisons — CPI alone (e.g. CHN/IND without OECD ULC) makes this force partial, never available.

definitions.name: Trade and capital flows
definitions.description: Size and balance of the country's trade and cross-border capital flows.
definitions.coverage_notes: World Bank WDI live (2000–2025, all 8 countries): exports/imports of goods and services, the published external balance (direct provider series for trade balance — not derived), and the current account. FDI net inflows (%GDP) live 1990+ all 8 countries (V1 Mission 1). Capital-flow measures beyond the current account and bilateral flows (UN Comtrade) come later.

definitions.name: Infrastructure and investment
definitions.description: Level and quality of infrastructure and fixed investment.
definitions.coverage_notes: World Bank gross capital formation live (2000–2025, all 8 countries) + fixed broadband per 100 (Mission 2). Investment effort + digital coverage context — NOT infrastructure quality.

definitions.name: Indebtedness
definitions.description: Level and trajectory of debt burdens across sectors.
definitions.coverage_notes: Private-sector credit gap + debt service (BIS) + general-government gross debt (IMF WEO, Sprint 5.19). Government debt is a raw level input only — no monotonic 'higher debt = weaker' curve is approved; debt sustainability depends on interest cost, currency, maturity, fiscal capacity, monetary sovereignty, and growth (CONTEXTUAL_DEFERRED in the normalization registry). Sprint 6.13 (DEC-040, ratified) added a score: CONDITION_MINUS_PENALTY composition, level = clamp(DSR + (credit_gap - 50), 0, 100), force-aggregation-v0.4.

definitions.name: Military strength
definitions.description: Military capability relative to potential adversaries.
definitions.coverage_notes: Live inputs are spending measures only (World Bank MS.MIL.XPND.CD / MS.MIL.XPND.GD.ZS, underlying source: SIPRI Military Expenditure Database). SIPRI describes military expenditure as an INPUT measure - resources absorbed by the military - not a measure of military capability or security. Personnel capability, equipment quality and quantity, technology, logistics, readiness, combat experience, alliances/force projection, and nuclear capability are not measured, so spending alone can never make this force AVAILABLE (DEC-009 ceiling).

definitions.name: Wealth / opportunity / values gaps
definitions.description: Gaps in wealth, opportunity, and values within the country.
definitions.coverage_notes: Live inputs: World Bank Gini index (income inequality, irregular) + WID top 10% net personal wealth share (wealth concentration, annual, Sprint 5.20). Both are distributional measures — opportunity gaps and values/social polarization remain missing. The force is capped at PARTIAL until its conceptual scope is better covered. WID data_quality column preserved but NOT used for filtering (official semantics unverified).

definitions.name: Internal conflict
definitions.description: Degree of internal conflict — rich vs poor, left vs right, religion, ethnicity.
definitions.coverage_notes: Initial institutional/conflict-risk proxy: WGI 'Political Stability and Absence of Violence/Terrorism' governance score (2025 revision, 0-100) live 1996-2024 for all 8 countries. It does NOT measure every form of domestic conflict (polarization, protests, distributional tension) — the force is capped at PARTIAL while this proxy is the only input; later ACLED / event data may strengthen it. Perception-based composite with measurement uncertainty. SOURCE indicator, not an Atlas force score.

definitions.name: Geography
definitions.description: Natural endowments, location, and geographic conditions.
definitions.coverage_notes: Mostly static; no time-series catalog indicator planned.

definitions.name: Acts of nature
definitions.description: Exposure to natural disasters, pandemics, and climate events.
definitions.coverage_notes: Verified structural exposure context (Mission 4 §18): WB EN.CLC.MDAT.ZS, an EM-DAT-derived % of population affected by droughts/floods/extreme temperatures averaged over 1990-2009 (published at 2009 only — no annual series). Pandemic and climate-change exposure have no legally accessible provider series ingested yet; missing values mean 'not published', never 'zero events'.

leadership_capabilities.notes: Sprint 6.21 (DEC-041): identity copies the WGI GE level_score. Institutional proxy — measures state capacity, never individual leaders. PARTIAL ceiling: one WGI dimension is not the whole leadership-capabilities concept.

education.notes: Sprint 6.4 (DEC-032): single OECD tertiary-attainment proxy condition; identity copies the indicator level_score (aligned raw percentage). relative/momentum/confidence stay deferred. coverage stays PARTIAL.

character_determination.notes: PARTIAL: level = LFP percentile vs WDI universe (wdi_lfp_v1). Narrow economic-participation proxy - not a measure of character/determination.

rule_of_law.notes: Single WGI core condition; identity inherits semantics.

corruption.notes: Single WGI core condition; identity inherits semantics.

resource_allocation_efficiency.notes: Investment & resource-allocation context only — inputs overlap productivity/infrastructure deliberately; investment intensity is not allocation efficiency.

global_openness.notes: Descriptive trade/capital/size context only — overlaps trade_capital_flows deliberately; no openness level exists.

productivity_output_growth.notes: Sprint 6.14 (DEC-042): level = OECD reference percentile (Option A); momentum = own-history % change, primary 5y window (Option C). Distinct dimensions — a percentile move is not productivity growth.

cost_competitiveness.notes: Mission 2 (delegated): REER % momentum only — signed change of the index (rising = real appreciation = declining price competitiveness), NEVER a competitiveness score.

indebtedness.notes: level = clamp(DSR + (credit_gap - 50), 0, 100): the one-sided vulnerability curve can only subtract from the DSR condition score; neutral gap (50) contributes nothing. Both numeric components required — missing gap defers, it is never treated as neutral. Government debt stays SUPPORTING_CONTEXT (DEC-040).

military_strength.notes: V1 Mission 1 (delegated working model): relative dimension = share of tracked-8 defence expenditure (RELATIVE_SHARE). Dimension-only — SIPRI expenditure is an INPUT measure of resources absorbed, never capability; level stays deferred.

wealth_opportunity_values_gaps.notes: Sprint 6.7 (DEC-034): single WID wealth-share proxy condition; identity copies the indicator level_score (100 * (1 - raw_share)). GINI_INDEX stays SUPPORTING_CONTEXT (income inequality != wealth concentration; not averaged, not combined). relative/momentum/confidence stay deferred. coverage stays PARTIAL.

internal_conflict.notes: Single WGI proxy condition; identity inherits semantics; coverage stays PARTIAL.

geography.notes: Mostly static; no time-series catalog indicator planned.

acts_of_nature.notes: Structural disaster-exposure context only — a multi-decadal average, not an annual series; missing never means zero.
